correctness.rationale: Exact factorial-block bijection and Gaussian ranking normalization give the formal generating function for every p,q>=2 and integer t>=2. The bound sum_{s=1}^{m-1} 1/binom(m,s)<=4/m implies the factorial composition bound R_b(q)<=4^(b-1)(q-b+1)!; this shows every multi-large-side block contributes O(q^(-(t-1))) relative to the explicitly summed one-block family. Consequently both conditional concentration and Rényi entropy formula follow by exact normalization. Independent exact permutation/orientation enumeration agrees with block dynamic programming in 57 instances; 15 additional leading-bound scenarios pass. The proof makes no claim beyond fixed p,t asymptotics.

value.rationale: For a canonical infinitely growing Euclidean polytope family, the theorem exposes a sharp separation between exponentially many geometric vertices and logarithmic order-t Renyi entropy. Although the 2^p condensed orientations carry O(q^-p) total Gaussian angular exposure, they asymptotically determine every fixed integer collision moment t>=2. The explicit conditional bias and all-moment formula characterize a geometric sampling phenomenon not determined by ordinary orientation counts or known radius/ellipsoid information.
